name: Hörmann Cover
description: The `hoermann_hcp` text sensor platform reports the door state as the motor names it, and the motor's serial number and firmware version.

config_entries.label: Door State
config_entries.description: The door state reported by the motor. Unlike the cover, it tells the vent and half-open positions apart. A new value is published only when the state changes. While the bus controller is not connected, the last value stays; the [binary sensor](https://esphome.io/components/cover/hoermann_hcp#binary-sensor) shows whether it is current. The possible values are: | Value            | Meaning                                  | | ---------------- | ---------------------------------------- | | `Open`           | Fully open                               | | `Opening`        | Moving to fully open                     | | `Closed`         | Fully closed                             | | `Closing`        | Moving to fully closed                   | | `Half open`      | Resting in the half-open position        | | `Moving to half` | Moving to the half-open position         | | `Vent position`  | Resting in the vent position             | | `Moving to vent` | Moving to the vent position              | | `Stopped`        | Stopped anywhere else                    |

config_entries.label: Name

config_entries.label: Icon
config_entries.description: Manually set the icon to use for the sensor in the frontend.

config_entries.label: Device Class
config_entries.description: The device class for the sensor. Only the `timestamp` and `date` device classes are supported. Set to `""` to remove the default device class of a sensor. Requires Home Assistant 2024.3 or newer.

config_entries.label: Hoermann Hcp ID
config_entries.description: Manually specify the ID of the `hoermann_hcp` hub. Only required if you have more than one hub.

config_entries.label: Serial Number
config_entries.description: The motor's serial number. It is requested once after the device starts and appears a moment later. If the motor does not send it after three attempts, 30 seconds apart, it stays unknown and a warning is logged. Defaults to the `diagnostic` entity category.
